claims.claim: Direct Tokunbo Valeo Alternator for Mercedes-Benz M278 - 439741
claims.evidence: Photo 0 confirms the Valeo brand and model FG18S032, which is the OEM part for the M278 engine.
The geographical origin of a used part cannot be determined from visual inspection of the item itself.
The witness report explicitly states that functionality and voltage production were not shown.
The witness noted that the condition of the internal bearings and whether the pulley spins smoothly were not shown.
Mileage is a property of the donor vehicle and is not recorded on the alternator housing.
While the housing is shown, the witness did not confirm the integrity of factory seals or screw heads.

risks.risk: Faulty voltage regulator or blown diodes.
risks.proof: A video clip showing a multimeter reading 13.5V-14.5V while the alternator is on a test bench.
risks.if_unproven: As a core unit requiring an electrical rebuild.

risks.proof: A video with clear audio of the pulley being spun rapidly by hand to check for grinding or play.

risks.risk: Worn out carbon brushes or slip rings.
risks.proof: A clear photo looking into the rear plastic cover vents or a load test report.
risks.if_unproven: As a high-mileage unit near the end of its service life.

proof_requests: Video of the alternator being spun on a test bench with a multimeter showing output voltage.
Video with sound of the pulley being spun by hand.
Close-up photo of the mounting points to check for cracks or ovaling.
response.reason: The witness has positively identified the specific Valeo model from the technical label. It can be priced at the worst-case value for a used unit of unknown functional condition.
